description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Accursed Centaur either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Liliana, Untouched by Death
uses.cardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it
